children: ProPetro said its PROPWR unit signed new contracts to provide approximately 230 MW of behind-the-meter power to a Targa subsidiary, lifting PROPWR’s total committed capacity to about 510 MW. Full deployment is expected in early 2028.
New contracts for ~230 MW with Targa
Adds long-term contracted load with an investment-grade counterparty, supporting revenue visibility.
Signals scale of the power business after recontracting; a key capacity KPI for PUMP.
Revenue ramp is multi-year; near-term P&L impact may be limited until build-out.
Creates optionality for higher-margin data center deals if secured.

This extends PUMP’s shift into PROPWR, building a contracted base with a large midstream operator. Next, watch for firm timelines, capex details, and any data center contracts or pricing that quantify returns and margin impact.
